lesson.grammar_point: there is / there are (affirmative, negative and questions)

listenings.text: Good morning, and welcome aboard the Bernina Express to St. Moritz. There are four stops on this trip. The trip is about two and a half hours. There is a restaurant car at the end of the train, with coffee and sandwiches. On your right, there is a beautiful lake. Please stay in your seat when the train is on the bridge. Thank you, and enjoy the view.

Hello, and welcome to Chur. My name is Martin, and I am your guide today. Chur is the oldest town in Switzerland. It is not a big town, but there is a lot to see. In the old part of town, there are small streets and old houses. There is a big church, and there are good cafes. Around the town, there are mountains. Is there a train to St. Moritz? Yes, there is. It is a beautiful trip.

extra_audio.text: Carlos and his wife are in Milan. They go to Tirano by train. In Tirano, there is a red train to St. Moritz. On the trip, there are mountains and a blue lake. In St. Moritz, there is a small station. They stay there for five days.

paras: Carlos and his wife are in Milan. From Milan, there is a train to Tirano, a small town in Italy. In Tirano, there is a red train: the Bernina Express. It goes up to St. Moritz, in Switzerland.

The trip is slow, but the view is beautiful. There are big mountains with snow. There is a blue lake, and there are small villages next to the rails. There are big windows on the train, so everybody takes photos.
In St. Moritz, there is a small station and there are many hotels. There is not a lot of noise. Carlos and his wife stay there for five days. There is one problem: there are no Brazilian restaurants!
